svg.title: Shadow: from Record to a saved workflow

g.text: Shadow: from Record to a saved workflow
How one recording becomes a workflow, file by file. Record v2 (feat/record-v2, merged 21 Oct 2026; updated 23 Oct 2026 after step 4, PR #15).
Numbers follow the order things happen. Replay, recovery and repair are left out.
file in recordings/<id>/ (deleted 24 h after saving)
app data: config, databases, caption cache
private words, emails, cards… become ███ before any model reads them
Every day I get KPI emails
from my team. I add each
it runs is worked out later
facts only: nothing is decided yet
Pictures (Screen on): one after each action
screen.jsonl: the words on screen, masked, each line with its box
shots.jsonl: one line per picture: taken, or skipped and why
OCR and the black-out run on the Mac (Shadow.app)
the audio never leaves the Mac: only masked text does
All of these files are written into recordings/<id>/
while you work, before you press Stop.
Narration: voice → timed text → masked text
00:01 "Every day I get these KPI emails"
with start and end times. It is matched
to the steps later, in 6 (one timeline).
transcribing runs at the same time as
picture reading, so Stop is faster
was: transcribing waited for the pictures
events → steps, by what they did
click on the sheet (a drawn grid)
x1 a click on a drawn grid
· a double click is one click
· a selection + its copy = one read
· tab switches with nothing done between are dropped
· a paste takes the copy made just before it
· a page opened in another tab is its own step
· noise is removed AND listed (x1, x2… with the reason);
the agent can put one back
was: selection clicks and clicks that
changed nothing stayed as steps, or
s3 click link "Daily KPIs - w/c 19 Oct"
+ approval added by code on steps that
+ a download adds a step that finds the saved file
(waits up to 60 s); later steps use a rename's new name
was: a model call here as well
code · evidence.ts: all the agent will read
one package: masked, at most 24k tokens
Pictures on: each step's picture → a vision
model writes a caption (kept in cache/vision/)
one timeline (the KPI test recording), in s-ids
00:12 s3 [mail.google.com] go: click link "Daily KPIs - w/c 19 Oct"
00:13 said: "I always take the newest one, and never one I…"
00:15 s4 [mail.google.com] reveal: click div "Print allIn new…"
weak target: found only by its text
00:16 s5 [mail.google.com] read: copy "Daily KPIs - w/c 19 Oct"
00:19 (left out x1) clicked the drawn grid
proposals: patterns code found, the agent decides
p1 date: s12 types "19 Oct", the day it was recorded
open directly comes ready too. A list item, a repeat,
all files, a constant are notes: the agent builds them
+ each step's class (go / act / reveal / read),
what appeared after it, words near the click,
the brain's only view of the recording
was: a narration list + screen notes,
~/Library/Application Support/Shadow/ (number = the step that writes it)
recordings/<id>/ one per recording, deleted 24 h after saving
trace.jsonl 2 every event, one a line
shots.jsonl 2 per picture: taken, or why not
screen.jsonl 2 words on screen, masked, boxes
voice.m4a 2 your voice (stays on the Mac)
meta.json 3 stopped at (8 adds saved at)
transcript.jsonl 3 what you said, masked, timed
memory.db 8 facts it remembers (7 reads them)
Only masked text reaches a model.
evidence.json, transcript.jsonl and screen.jsonl are masked when written.
trace.jsonl, the pictures and voice.m4a never go to a model.
The one exception: with Pictures on, the blacked-out pictures
go to the vision model for captions.
after Stop, 5 and 6 hand the brain its input
Nemotron 3 Super, in stages run by code (design/v2/orchestrator.ts). One budget for the whole design:
$0.25 and 40 model calls, captions included. A reply cut off at the token cap gets one more episode.
It only ever reads masked text.
an agent with tools, up to 8 calls a turn:
· loop (around steps, or new ones) / branch
code refuses a step the runner can't run,
and a call resent as it failed
in the automation window: opens pages,
types, sends or presses acting buttons;
a file this run would download is only
what it still can't tell, in one batch:
· a rule you said isn't built ("the newest" too)
· a check uses text that never appeared on screen
· a test failed unexplained, or couldn't start
· a step can't run (stale check, wrong tab)
· how often doesn't match, or isn't a fixed time
After 2 refusals it saves with the gaps listed,
unless your work is lost or a step can't run:
then your recorded steps are kept
refused → fix it and try again
rules refuse harm: no unvisited site, no
scripts, no approval turned off, no Never;
and steps the runner can't run (no control
it can find, a role alone, missing values)
from the recording; no new clicks
the test run's log: each step found /
not found / done, and what it read:
the agent sees each AI step's answer
the feed says first what it
was: asked one by one, every
some lost to a bad id
or the recorded steps if worse
design.json is the record of everything it did:
the prompt, the task model, each decision and
change with its why, the test report, questions
and answers, gaps, the transcript with its
evidence all that code learned about the
proposal a change code prepares; the agent
task model what the agent thinks the task
finish gate code's checklist before a design
reports/section-study-record-v2.md how each part works now
reports/section-study.md how it was before v2
v1.json: the workflow. Each change makes v2, v3…; none is overwritten
(at save, an AI step's list gets the fields its loop reads)
review.json: each change's badge and reason, what you said → what was
built, what wasn't tested, the gaps
meta.json: saved at. The recordings/<id>/ folder is deleted 24 h later
was: a design could save itself as the next version of another
workflow (it reused the model's id); now the daemon's id, always
Example: what a correct KPI design shows
s13 read all the inbox's subjects (for the newest)
s12 "19 Oct" → {{today|D MMM}}: you typed today
s4 the click on the header: it changed nothing
s7 typing into the sheet: never done in a test
What you said → what was built
"always the newest one" → a loop over the new emails
This is where the record side
was: a summary from the model that could describe changes
never made, and Go live with no review
The first real KPI run built no loop (F2) and ran by hand (F1).
